newsitem.title: USA: Outlook sales effort, divestiture pay off.
newsitem.headline: Outlook sales effort, divestiture pay off.

text.p: Outlook Group Corp said Wednesday its fourth quarter profit was the result of steps it took to build a strong sales team and divest businesses that do not fit its long-term plan.

"There continues to be much hard work ahead of us, but the results of the fourth quarter reflect the many steps taken over the last year to return Outlook Group to profitability," David Erdmann, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
Outlook reported a fourth quarter net profit of $0.05 a share versus a loss of $0.85 a share last year. For the year, the company's net loss was $0.32 a share, compared with a loss of $1.19 a share.
During the quarter, Outlook sold its Barrier Films subsidiary. The company said its Outlook Foods unit is expected to be sold within the next 90 days.
"With the sale of Outlook Foods, we wil further strengthen our balance sheet to allow us to focus on growing our graphics, label and packaging operations," Erdmann said.
Outlook Group is a graphic services and packaging company.
